findings.title: The owner sentence introducing the CHECK SCOPE / PATH fence carries walk provenance into a baseline-bound requirement
findings.recommendation: Walk 1's fix for the installed-skill pointer opens the fence's introducing sentence with '(system walk 1, Sal: B — an installed skill cannot open this spec, ...)'. Measured: no file under orbit/specs/ carries walk provenance ('walk 1', 'Sal: B' — zero matches across every baseline), and this sentence syncs into orbit-emit-composition's baseline at archive, where a walk number is history with no reader. Keep the reason and drop the provenance: 'An installed skill cannot open this spec, so the review and walk bodies carry it as a CHECKED MIRROR held byte-equal by a parity test.' The walk log and design D-notes already record who decided it.

findings.title: The address-reviews next_recommended is still composed from the caller's live payload while the bytes come from the frozen record
findings.recommendation: Walk 2 moved the walk checks and ripple_misses onto the materialized record, as external C1 asked; the post-write composition one step earlier still builds its synthetic-trail candidate as {...emit}, whose resolutions is the caller's live array. Probed in a disposable project: live entry (A, a.md) resolved, toJSON returning (B, b.md) stale — the stamp read '/orbit:review --as proposal foo' while the status computed from the written log read '/orbit:address-reviews foo --from-file …'. Pre-existing (the candidate predates rc08a) and programmatic-only: a CLI payload is parsed JSON and carries no hooks. The smallest closure is to materialize the payload once at entry to composeAndWriteEmit (JSON round trip), so every later read — composition, checks, bytes — is one inert record; or name the programmatic limit as a residual.

commentary: Graded the 14 owed entries over each sweep scope (file, ripple_cascade.applied, sweep.scope), reading the walks' diff from 038a7e0c — the commit that added the external return, the latest accepted independent pass — to the walked tree. The residual check listed 15 files and every one sits in some entry's edit record. The engine edits were read line by line against their claims: the frozen-record move, the never-read predicate's two bases, the three refusals for unreadable members, the file-only kept, and the reader's key on both sides of the pointer. Each claim holds, and the regression tests exercise each by execution. The two findings sit beside the walks rather than in their engine work: one is provenance prose bound for a baseline; the other is a seam one step earlier than the one C1 closed, measured by probe rather than inferred.
